narr: Clusters of thunderstorms developed during the midday into the afternoon hours. Many of the thunderstorms produced brief gusty winds and locally heavy rainfall. Repetitive thunderstorms produced excessive rainfall of 3-6 inches in a portion of north central Lauderdale County north and northwest of Florence, resulting in flash flooding.
